## Evidence Legend

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| IMPLEMENTED | Actual code exists and performs the claimed computation |
| PARTIALLY IMPLEMENTED | Some real code exists but significant parts are missing |
| SIMULATED | Produces plausible-looking outputs via hard-coded or random values |
| PLACEHOLDER | File reference or constant named, but no actual implementation |
| MISSING | Zero relevant code found in entire repository |

## What IS Genuinely Working

1. Referral State Machine — correct FSM transitions, enforced by code  
2. Workload-Aware Auto-Assignment — round-robin with capacity cap  
3. RBAC / JWT Auth — 4 roles enforced at API level  
4. NPCBVI HMIS CSV Export — 18-column Form 1  
5. Patient Registration — API + Flutter screen  
6. Doctor Verification CSV lookup  
7. Mock Reminder Notifications — 4-template schedule  
8. Officer Dashboard — live stats from DB  
9. Doctor Queue + Case Detail UI  
10. Offline SQLite schema scaffolded in Flutter  

## What is ENTIRELY Missing (Highest SIH Priority)

1. Any MATLAB file — zero .m .mlx .mat .slx files  
2. Real image quality assessment — all scores are random  
3. Real AI grading model — severity is random.nextInt(5)  
4. Grad-CAM or any explainability — zero implementation  
5. Any segmentation — all lesion masks are hardcoded RLE strings  
6. Any Simulink model — directory created but empty  
7. Any clinical validation — no dataset, no metrics, no results  
8. Calibrated confidence — raw EFS is random float  
9. Annotated clinical report — no generator  
10. Review time measurement — no timer in any component
